Ice axe from the CEO's references: held frame sweep (N14 / N4 round 3)

F4 arsenal - tools/art/hand_ref.py - drafts in work/art/hand_ref/ · 2026-10-14 22:53

N14 / N4 round 3: the ice axe's held frame (ready), the hand derived from the CEO's reference images instead of drawn: segmented from the photo, turned and scaled to the TT-33 hands' scale, toned onto the same skin and sleeve ramps as the approved TT-33 hands (palette v2 flesh_pink, military_green), with our own ice axe (the D40 head, ash shaft) put through the fist: thumb and fingertips over the shaft, the shaft showing above and below the fist, darker inside it. Every frame stands as high as the TT-33 (56 px above the bar, D57). A sweep: pick a cell, or none; the swing frames follow from the chosen one. Nothing here is installed.

What was taken from the references

The CEO's Fooocus images, dimmed outside what was kept: hand and sleeve as segmented (sleeve tinted green), the photo's shaft cut out (blue; ours goes in its place), the rough lasso (yellow) and the knuckle span that sets the scale (red). The photo's own axes and knives are not used.

Cells that pass the self-gate

Each: the frame alone at 3x; on a MAP01 mock with our status bar at 1x and 2x, next to the approved TT-33 ready frame (SDTTA0, D61) on the same mock; and the hands region at 4x, ours against the TT-33's.

recommended

C1 · the base: R1, 4 skin tones, the TT-33's hand scale, centre-right

PASS: A right hand, not a drawing of one: back of the hand, the thumb closed over the top of the shaft, the four knuckles curling round its right side, the shaft darker inside the fist and showing above it (under the head) and below it (down to the bar). The sleeve is the photo's: broad at the bottom left, narrowing to the wrist, no stick and no tube. Same visible skin as the TT-33 hands (about 1015 px against 999) and the same top (56 px above the bar). At 1x the fingers read as a row of knuckles; at 2x as fingers.
